legal.metaTitle: Notice on the protection of foreign patients' rights
legal.title: Notice on the protection of foreign patients' rights
legal.lead: PibooK is a foreign patient referral agency. This page explains what you should know before you use it.
legal.demoNotice: This is demo text. Before the real service opens it will be replaced with text reviewed by legal counsel.

service.title: What the service is and its terms
service.content: PibooK's AI agent organizes your request, asks clinics for quotes, checks the prices against past payment records, and passes your booking request to the clinic.
service.noMedical: PibooK does not provide medical care. Diagnosis, whether a procedure suits you, and the procedure itself are the responsibility of the clinic's doctors.
service.price: Amounts shown are quotes. A reference price that PibooK gives on a clinic's behalf may differ from the actual price. The clinic confirms the final amount.
service.explain: Before a procedure the clinic explains the diagnosis, the treatment method, possible side effects, the treatment agreement, the expected cost, and how disputes are resolved.
service.fee: PibooK may receive a referral fee from a clinic within the limit set by law. That fee does not affect which clinics are shown or how prices are checked. PibooK does not charge customers.
service.eligibility: Clinic matching and booking are available only to foreign nationals on a short stay. They are not available to Korean nationals or to people living in Korea with an alien registration or residence report.

dispute.title: How disputes are resolved
dispute.contact: Send questions and complaints to PibooK first. The contact details will be shown here before the service opens (demo).
dispute.mediation: You can also consult public bodies such as the Korea Medical Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Agency (KOMEDI) about medical disputes. The Korea Health Industry Development Institute (KHIDI) also has a support desk for foreign patients.
dispute.records: To help review a complaint, PibooK keeps records of your requests, quotes and bookings, and passes them to the clinic if you ask.

privacy.title: Protection of personal information
privacy.collected: We handle your nickname, nationality, age band, dates, contact details, skin concerns, past procedures, safety information and procedure records.
privacy.purpose: We use them to run your agent, find clinics, request quotes, make bookings and check prices.
privacy.sensitive: Skin, procedure and safety information is health information, which is sensitive. We ask for your consent to it separately from the other consents. A clinic receives only what you agreed to share, when you send a booking.
privacy.crossBorder: Information entered outside Korea is processed on servers in Korea. We may use overseas providers for AI processing and storage. We ask for a separate consent for this as well.
privacy.retention: Your information is kept until you delete it in My data.
privacy.rights: In My data you can view your agent card, export your data as JSON, switch consents on or off, and delete everything.
privacy.anonymous: Only if you agree to anonymous sharing are your records anonymized and used as a price reference. We never publish results as public reviews.
